tools.purpose: Calculate reminder dates from a user-entered renewal date and notice period.
tools.formula: renewal date minus notice period; date arithmetic only
assumptions: user-entered date and notice period are accurate
tools.limitations: Not a legal deadline and does not interpret a contract.

tools.purpose: Compare base price, required fees, optional fees, taxes, and recurring charges entered by the user.
tools.formula: base plus one-time charges plus recurring fee times periods plus entered tax/other charge
assumptions: tax treatment is not independently determined
tools.limitations: Not a market benchmark, legal finding, or savings prediction.
